Method of Attack: Ransomware attack appending the '*.s0fts3rve555-***' extension to encrypted files
DLL hijacking vulnerability exploited in the legitimate Rainmeter application to deploy ransomware
DLL side-loading using malicious Rainmeter.dll compiled from legitimate source
Use of CobaltStrike Beacon and PowerShell scripts to find changed files and deploy malware
Attack Vector: DLL hijacking vulnerability in Rainmeter Windows customization tool
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with extension pattern '*.s0fts3rve555-***' (e.g., s0fts3rve555-76e9b8bf)
Malicious Rainmeter.dll identified as backdoor Win32/PyXie.A
PowerShell script timestamps indicating attack between 2 AM and 9 AM
Leaked source code repositories allegedly stolen during attack
